Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000661" [decision]: On 2025-09-02 the Atlas team decided that clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000594": Priya Raman holds the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000582": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team on-call rotation, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000568": The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000557": Diego has the Cinder pager as of 2025-07-17, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000548": The billing API is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000514": The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-27; the earlier handover note of 2025-06-11 saying Cinder took ownership was written against the wrong team, and Cinder never owned it.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000506": The job scheduler is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-25, having moved from the Ember team.  (about: Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000424" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000409" [decision]: Cinder adopted trunk-based development.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000404": On 2025-05-14 the Cinder team observed that webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhooks)
- memory_id "1000364": As of 2025-04-24, the Cinder team reported that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000343": The product catalog keeps image metadata in a separate table because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000341" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000328": The image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000325": The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000273" [constraint]: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000165": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000155": The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000112": Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000026": Diego is on Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka is on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder)
Existing entity names: Atlas team, feature-flags, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Ember team, Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego, Boreal team, billing API, Dune team, notifier, job scheduler, indexer, webhooks, product catalog, image resizer, INC-2025-004
